### 1 — Scene
A breakfast-style plate, apparently containing fried potato pieces, scrambled eggs, bacon, white cheese, and a little chopped vegetable salsa. The bright sunlight makes the white topping somewhat uncertain; I’m treating it as soft, crumbly cheese.
